clauses.text: Mobile phones are repaired, replaced or reimbursed at market value for Accidental Damage from Handling and for Mechanical or Electrical Breakdown, and are also reimbursed or replaced due to Loss and Theft. Up to 4 mobile phones per household.

clauses.heading: Exclusions
clauses.text: Coverage does not include damage from nature, flood, war, terrorism, fires, wind, lightning strikes or other Acts of God. Full exclusions are in the insurance policy.

clauses.heading: Claim details
clauses.text: Claims can be filed immediately after enrollment and must be reported within 60 days of the incident. Customers have 30 days from opening a claim to provide all necessary documentation, otherwise the claim will be closed. A non-refundable deductible is required for all claims.

clauses.heading: Claim limits
clauses.text: Accidental Damage from Handling and Mechanical and Electrical Breakdowns: unlimited claims with a cap of $2,500 per approved claim. Loss and Theft: 2 approved claims with a cap of $2,500 per approved claim in any rolling 12-month period.
